anatomy_notes.source: Direct Time Stranger chr718 model and 1.633333437-second native chr718_bn01 loop; four endpoint-exclusive samples.

anatomy_notes.face: Separate source eye meshes; inspect native-size contrast before any source-bounded treatment.
anatomy_notes.silhouette: Preserve source helmet, armor, shield, long blade, legs and boots.
anatomy_notes.offsets: J_neck is the closest native head anchor; J_hand_l/r are anatomical hands.
anatomy_notes.ground: Grounded armored biped; assess actual boot contact separately from sword and shield extrema.
